name: Cloudponte Bridge
description: The multi-tier bridge and rail line up to Park Heights on which Kitt's train is stopped.

timeline.summary: Kitt boards a third-class train up Cloudponte Bridge, carrying Halo vials in her jacket and a gown in the bag.
timeline.quote: So that was how she found herself on a Cloudponte Bridge train for the first time in her entire sorry life

timeline.summary: The train stops and Riveteers blow up the rails, then the viashino Ognis tells the passengers she is looking for Henzie's goods.
timeline.quote: "There's somethin' our old pal Henzie owes us, and he knows it

timeline.summary: Kitt starts a brawl among the passengers and escapes through the window onto the tracks.
timeline.quote: Kitt jumped up onto the bench and, with a heave of her shoulders and a burst of adrenalin, popped open the window.
